Request for Information (RFI) for Project 16: Uncrewed Systems NATO–Ukraine Capability Development.

Due date for questions concerning related information: **17:00 CEST 22 July 2026**.

Due date for submission of requested information: **17:00 CEST 03 August 2026**.
